static_traits.name: Lin Taile
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; have not received other psychological counseling before; shoulder pain appeared for the first time and has lasted for months.
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, highly cooperative; clear expression, able to describe symptoms and trigger situations; able to self-observe and willing to try suggestions; feeling frustrated and stressed due to pain.

basic_info.main_problem: I have been experiencing shoulder pain, which I believe was caused by the sling. But I also feel my weight may have worsened the discomfort.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because shoulder pain affects my daily life and causes discomfort; I hope to find better ways to manage it, and I am willing to explore adjustments and suggestions.

core_beliefs: My physical condition (weight) is the root of the problem; the pain is mainly caused by my own factors

special_situations.event: Shoulder pain clearly worsens when wearing a sling
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If pain occurs while wearing the sling, it is mainly because my weight is too great, causing the shoulder to bear too much load
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries adjusting the straps, reducing wearing time, and considers relieving the shoulder burden through self-management
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my weight straining my shoulders

special_situations.event: Pain worsens when performing heavy physical or repetitive activities that strain the shoulders
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If pain occurs during these activities, it is because I have not taken good care of myself / my weight is too high
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or avoids heavy physical activity, rests frequently to reduce pain
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did not do well enough, that is why it hurts

special_situations.event: Talking with friends about shoulder pain but they are unable to offer solutions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others cannot help me, it means the problem lies with me; it is my personal fault
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes the cause to oneself and tries to find solutions alone

core_conflict.wish: Longs to reduce physical pain and obtain effective support and solutions
core_conflict.fear: Fears the pain will persist and affect life functioning and emotional state
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control over the problem through self-explanation and self-adjustment

object_relations.self_representation: Individual who needs help but is troubled by pain
object_relations.object_representation: Others/friends who care but are unable to provide practical solutions

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the cause of pain is unclear and symptoms keep affecting daily functioning
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to attribute the pain mainly to their own weight, thereby simplifying complex factors and maintaining a controllable explanation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using gentle, exploratory language, proposing multiple possible causes, avoiding directly negating their Interpretation; inviting joint testing of hypotheses and gathering evidence through experiments.

manifestations: Shoulder pain limits daily activities and physical Freedom (such as Wearing a sling, limited during heavy physical activity)
outcomes: Decreased convenience of life and limited functioning

positive_force: Willing to seek help and maintain a positive attitude(came on own initiative, willing to try suggestions)
Has self-observation ability, able to identify the relationship between pain and the sling, activities
Has some social support (a few friends to confide in)
negative_force: Shoulder pain persists, causing limited activity and inconvenience
Excessive personalization attribution, tends to blame the pain on weight
Stress and emotional distress caused by pain
Currently lacking effective pain management strategies (adjusting the sling and painkillers have limited effect)

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids or reduces activities that strain the shoulder due to shoulder pain
antecedent: Performs heavy physical or repetitive activities that strain the shoulder
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about worsening the pain and experiencing significant discomfort
target_behavior.function: Escaping pain and discomfort, reducing immediate physical load
target_behavior.consequence: Daily activities limited, Decreased efficiency, reduced convenience of life

target_behavior.behavior: Self-blaming thinking (attributing pain mainly to weight)
antecedent: Communication situations where others are unable to provide solutions
target_behavior.core_reason: Gaining psychological Interpretation and a sense of control through single-cause attribution, reducing Anxiety from uncertainty
target_behavior.function: Maintaining a subjective sense of control and problem framing
target_behavior.consequence: Increasing self-blame and stress, possibly overlooking other causes and solutions, the problem not being effectively relieved
